description.value: A photosynthetic sessile of Marrow's braided meltwater plain, which spends two centuries as a dormant tuber under frost and completes an entire life in the few decades of the thaw. Growth is violent by any standard: a bloom goes from tuber to full height in nineteen days and sets seed twice before the channels shift under it. The plain turns green over about a year and stays that way until the frost returns.
